notes: REF-BM-02: only page title is auto-fetched (title.js); no description, favicon, or preview image collected. REF-BM-03: title editable only after save (edit form); no title field before saving and no description field at all. REF-BM-04: edit form covers only title and tags; url, description, and note are not editable. REF-BM-07: list rows show title, url, tags; no description and no favicon. REF-BM-12: search covers title, url, and tags only; description and note fields do not exist in the model, so not searched. REF-BM-14: no #tag search syntax—typing #x matches nothing since tags are stored without '#'. REF-BM-15: search is plain substring; no AND/OR/NOT or parentheses. REF-BM-16: no quoted-phrase exact match. REF-BM-20: no multi-select or bulk actions. REF-BM-21: no filter-scoped bulk operation. REF-BM-22: list is fixed newest-first (date added); no sort-key selection or other keys. REF-BM-23: no note field or markdown rendering. REF-BM-24/25: no local HTML/PDF snapshot and no Internet Archive support. REF-BM-29: no bundles/saved filters. REF-BM-30/31: no Netscape HTML import or export. REF-BM-32: no user/display settings (sort, items per page, font size).
